issue_title: Signed URL path loses a leading slash
issue_text: An HTTPS URL containing a path that begins with two slashes can be changed before it is sent. This breaks URLs whose signatures depend on the exact path. Reproduce by preparing such a request and inspecting the path passed to the adapter. Both leading slashes should be preserved.
success_criteria: Signed HTTPS paths preserve their leading slashes and ordinary HTTP double-slash requests remain usable.
